apps.name: Slack
apps.description: Messaging, with room for your workflow.

mods.name: Slack Triage
mods.author: PimpMyElectron
mods.summary: Triage unread Slack work from an edge inbox with native open and reply actions.
mods.description: An edge-docked, keyboard-driven inbox with cached hover previews, quick replies, and native Slack conversations, threads, compose, search, and Activity views.
features: An inbox at the edge of your screen
Native Slack conversations and composer
Multi-workspace unread notifications
Keyboard triage and personal thread names
Density, accent, and translucency controls
mods.access: Observes Slack’s cached state without background API polling. Opening conversations, replying, searching, and changing read state use Slack’s normal native interface and requests; missing cached observations are never treated as empty or read.

mods.name: Reply Tools
mods.author: PimpMyElectron
mods.summary: Quote text or reply with Slack’s message preview.
mods.description: Adds Quote in reply and Reply with preview to Slack’s message action bar. Both preserve your draft and work in channels, DMs, and existing threads, independently or alongside Slack Triage.
features: Quote rendered text or insert a native message preview
Press Q over a message to reply with its preview
Optional compact native message-preview cards
Preserves existing drafts and native undo
Works in ordinary Slack and triage conversations
Never sends messages automatically
mods.access: Reads the clicked message’s rendered text or permalink and edits the local native composer. No API calls, background message collection, or additional permissions.

settings.label: Use Q for Reply with preview
settings.description: Active only while a message is hovered or its preview action has keyboard focus; typing in a non-empty editor always wins.

settings.label: Compact message-preview cards
settings.description: Limits forwarded/native preview cards to three text lines and smaller media.

mods.name: Message Polish
mods.author: PimpMyElectron
mods.summary: Make Slack messages calmer, denser, and easier to scan.
mods.description: Adds copy controls for code, preserves long code lines, gives each sender a subtle stable tint, offers compact message spacing, labels supported truncated links from their URL alone, and quiets Slack’s message toolbar.
features: Copy buttons and non-wrapping code blocks
Subtle stable colors for each sender
Independent dense text and compact message-spacing controls
Readable labels for supported Google Workspace links without metadata requests
A calmer message-action toolbar
Compatible with Triage and Quote in Reply
mods.access: Reads rendered message structure and supported link URLs; message text is read only when you choose Copy. Readable labels are derived locally from each URL without fetching metadata. The mod changes local presentation, writes copied code to the clipboard, makes no API requests, and stores no message content.

settings.label: Keep long code lines on one line
Remove extra space between messages
settings.description: Removes Slack’s message gutter padding and uses an 18 px message line height.

settings.label: Use readable labels for supported links
settings.description: Parses supported Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides URLs locally; no metadata request is made.

settings.label: Sender tint intensity
settings.description: 5 is very subtle; 100 is the strongest supported tint.

mods.name: Slack Appearance
mods.author: PimpMyElectron
mods.summary: Give Slack a calmer color palette of your own.
mods.description: Apply an original bundled palette or custom Slack theme colors to the local desktop session. Import four- or eight-color Slack theme strings and switch themes without restarting.
features: Eight locally bundled appearance presets
Custom navigation, selection, presence, and badge colors
Coordinated channel, thread-header, tab, and composer surfaces
Four- and eight-color Slack theme-string import
Immediate updates in a running Slack session
Restores Slack's native appearance when disabled
mods.access: Changes local CSS colors in the managed Slack session. It does not read credentials, write account preferences, contact a theme gallery, or sync colors to other devices.

settings.label: Import Slack theme string
settings.description: Paste four or eight comma-separated six-digit hex colors. Importing switches the preset to Custom colors.

mods.name: Slack Custom CSS
mods.author: PimpMyElectron
mods.summary: Add carefully guarded local CSS to Slack.
mods.description: An advanced escape hatch for small personal Slack style adjustments. Network-capable, escaped, oversized, legacy executable, and PME-targeting CSS is rejected before it is saved or injected.
features: Live local CSS updates without restarting Slack
Blocks imports, URLs, image sets, and legacy executable syntax
Protects PME-owned controls from direct targeting
Bounded to 8,000 characters
One-click recovery by disabling the mod in PME
mods.access: Injects only the CSS you enter into the managed Slack renderer. It cannot load remote resources through CSS, and it never reads credentials or writes Slack account preferences. Custom styles can still break Slack's presentation until disabled.

settings.label: Custom CSS
settings.description: Advanced: applies to the managed Slack renderer. Imports, URLs, escapes, legacy executable syntax, and PME selectors are rejected.

mods.name: Personal Emoji
mods.author: PimpMyElectron
mods.summary: Render your own local shortcode aliases.
mods.description: Map up to 50 personal shortcode names to public HTTPS images, including multiple local aliases per image. Emoji-only messages receive Slack-style jumbo sizing. Rendering remains local and never changes the message Slack stores.
features: Personal aliases without workspace upload privileges
Up to 10 additional shortcode aliases per image
Slack-style jumbo sizing for one to three emoji-only messages
Public HTTPS image URLs only
No-referrer lazy image loading
Provider hook for reviewed private registry mods
Never changes or sends message content
Restores shortcode text when disabled
mods.access: Reads rendered message text to replace configured shortcodes locally. The configured public image host receives normal image requests and your IP address; PME sends no Slack credentials or message text to it.

settings.label: Personal emoji definitions
settings.description: One image per line. Put aliases before the URL, for example: :shipit: :deploy: https://example.com/shipit.png. Public HTTPS hosts only; up to 10 aliases per image and 50 names total.

mods.name: Sidebar Productivity
mods.author: PimpMyElectron
mods.summary: Focus, group, preview, open, and reply in a separate Slack window.
mods.description: Add a policy-safe Unified Sidebar for rows Slack has already mounted, responsive modes, recoverable destination hiding, cache-only message previews, full Open navigation, and Reply in a separate Slack conversation window. Each capability is independently switchable.
features: Optional Unified Sidebar with custom groups and deterministic activity ordering
Reviewed application of local groups to native Slack channel sections
Independent destination hiding, cached preview, Open, and warm-reused separate-window Reply controls
Optional hidden reply prewarming for near-instant first use at an additional memory cost
Compact, auto-hide, and conversation-only sidebar modes
Workspace-scoped hidden destinations with recovery
Keyboard-focus and hover support
Privacy-safe rendering diagnostics for layout bug reports
No API calls or background message polling
mods.access: Reads Slack's rendered sidebar and a bounded projection of IDs and latest timestamps from already-observed renderer state. Unified Sidebar reorders only rows Slack has already mounted; it never opens conversations, expands sections, fetches history, or fills cache gaps. An explicit reviewed Apply action can use Slack's own Create section and Move channel menus for configured channels, stopping on the first unconfirmed step. Open uses Slack's rendered navigation. Reply asks Slack to open the matching same-origin conversation in its own native window; it does not navigate or cover the main Slack window, and PME never types or sends content. Optional reply prewarming starts one hidden Slack renderer seeded only from the conversation already open; it uses additional memory but does not pre-open hovered destinations. Copied diagnostics contain mode flags, element counts, and coarse geometry, not destination names, IDs, group definitions, or message data.

settings.label: Enable Unified Sidebar
settings.description: Groups and orders only the native rows Slack has already mounted. Switch between Unified Inbox and Classic view inside Slack.

settings.label: Show Hide controls for destinations and sections
settings.description: Adds per-destination Hide controls and a workspace-scoped recovery list.

settings.label: Enable cached message previews
settings.description: Uses only messages Slack has already loaded. A cache miss is labeled honestly and never triggers a request.

settings.label: Show Open action
settings.description: Remains available when cached previews are off or a destination has no cached message.

settings.label: Show Reply in new window action
settings.description: Opens Slack's matching conversation and native composer in a separate Slack window without changing the main view.

settings.label: Keep quick-reply window warm
settings.description: Starts one hidden Slack reply renderer from the conversation already open so later Reply actions can appear much faster. Uses additional memory while enabled and does not pre-open hovered destinations.

settings.label: Preview delay
settings.description: Delay in milliseconds before a hover preview appears. Keyboard focus previews immediately.

settings.label: Use compact sidebar strip
settings.description: Collapses the channel sidebar to a narrow strip until hover or keyboard focus.

settings.label: Auto-hide sidebar when narrow
settings.description: Hides only the channel sidebar below the auto-hide threshold.

settings.label: Use conversation-only small-window mode
settings.description: Hides the channel sidebar and navigation rail below the conversation-only threshold.

settings.label: Auto-hide threshold
settings.description: Window width in pixels used by Auto-hide mode.

settings.label: Conversation-only threshold
settings.description: Window width in pixels used by Conversation-only mode.

mods.name: Slack Layout
mods.author: PimpMyElectron
mods.summary: Make Slack chrome adapt to the way you work.
mods.description: Choose which navigation and channel-header controls remain visible, tune thread width and message actions, and simplify the top bar. Pair it with Sidebar Productivity for destination organization and responsive sidebar modes.
features: Per-item navigation and channel-header controls
Single-line headers and configurable thread width
Pointer-following message toolbar
Full, hidden, or top-bar rail modes with recoverable overflow placement
Automatically suspends layout changes inside Triage
mods.access: Reads Slack's rendered navigation structure and changes local presentation. It makes no API requests and does not read message content.

settings.label: Hidden rail buttons
settings.description: Places the overflow for hidden rail actions in the top bar or beside the sidebar header.

settings.label: Thread pane width
settings.description: 0 keeps Slack's default; otherwise choose 320–900 pixels.

mods.name: Menu Player
mods.author: PimpMyElectron
mods.summary: Your player and mini library in the menu bar.
mods.description: Hover for playback controls, then expand to browse liked songs, playlists, albums, search, and queue without leaving your work.
features: Now playing in a hoverable menu-bar widget
Play, pause, previous, and next track
Browse your library, liked songs, playlists, and albums
Search music and add tracks to your queue
Works with your existing Spotify sign-in
Keeps working after the manager closes
mods.access: Playback controls use macOS Automation. Mini Library uses Spotify’s own client interfaces through a private inherited pipe, with no debugging port or separate Spotify Web API credentials. Browsing and search can fetch data through Spotify. Artwork loads from Spotify’s image CDN.

mods.name: Camera Pause
mods.author: PimpMyElectron
mods.summary: Music pauses when your camera comes on.
mods.description: Choose the apps whose camera use should pause Spotify. Resume only music this mod paused, once none of those apps is using the camera.
features: Choose conferencing apps or browsers to watch
Configurable resume delay after camera activity ends
Live status for the app currently using the camera
Resume only playback paused by this mod
Works on its own or alongside Menu Player
mods.access: Observes local macOS camera-activity diagnostics and uses macOS Automation to control Spotify. No camera or microphone recording, browser inspection, or Spotify library connection. App attribution depends on macOS diagnostic support.
